problem.text: Autosplit hard-coded its initial dummy input as a batch of integer token IDs, preventing models from specifying a different input shape or dtype.

reasoning.text: Moving that specification into an overridable model method preserves the text-model default while allowing specialized models to reuse the existing loading and memory-probing loop.

impact.text: This supplies an extension point, not a vision implementation: the diff adds no specialized override, architecture registration or image preprocessing.

source_notes.text: The root models entry was read; it describes the existing sequential dummy-forward autosplit mechanism and single-device alternative.

Issue #7, “quantizing model: undefined symbol: __cxa_call_terminate,” and issue #6, “No ROCm runtime is found, using ROCM_HOME='/usr',” concern native-extension import/build failures. Their relationship to this change is only an inferred file overlap: both tracebacks pass through model.py, whereas this diff changes autosplit input metadata, not imports.

limitations: No GPU loading or memory-placement tests were run. A scalar arithmetic check would not establish the behavior of this dispatch-only change.

Arbitrary initial shape does not remove downstream requirements: autosplit still forwards one zero-filled tensor with empty parameter dictionaries, bypasses Model.prepare_inputs, and assumes three-dimensional state when processing a logits_output module.
No concrete non-text override was supplied or executed; compatibility with particular vision models remains unestablished.

claims.text: Model.default_load_shape_dtype(chunk_size) returns ((1, chunk_size), torch.long). The leading 1 preserves the single-batch probe; chunk_size remains the requested probe sequence length. _load_autosplit now obtains both initial metadata values through self, enabling subclass dispatch without changing its arguments.

The metadata feeds torch.zeros on the selected load device. After the first module, autosplit retains intermediate tensor shape and dtype for retries; an out-of-memory failure unloads the module, discards the dummy tensor and advances to another device. Thus the new hook changes the initial probe, not the splitting policy or intermediate-state recovery mechanism.

Whole-parent-tree search found no existing default_load_shape_dtype definition or use. The sole direct caller of _load_autosplit is load_gen; its explicit-device branch instead calls _load_single and does not use the new hook. load consumes load_gen for synchronous loading.

The constructor also initializes an empty model-level caps dictionary. This is separate from the module.caps checks used by autosplit for CPU preference and logits handling; the new shape hook does not depend on it. The remaining edits correct quotation in the component assertion message and add a trailing parameter comma.

annotation.summary: Adds an overridable autosplit input-shape/dtype hook while preserving the integer-token default, plus an empty model capability dictionary.
